segments: 5-5 input editing (caret + command history; no contract method)
scope: terminal client contract coverage: configure an agent from the terminal, run a capability self-check, publish user constraints, and read a task's persisted result, closing the create-session -> configure-agents -> verify-endpoint -> steer-the-session -> read-the-result loop; plus the last leftover UX item, single-line caret editing and per-pane command history

contract_coverage.remaining: none; every method in docs/core-api.md is reachable from the terminal

agent_configuration.role_mapping: pane 1 -> coordinator, panes 2-4 -> worker; the user cannot pick a role, matching the agent/list pane mapping
agent_configuration.id_generation: empty pane gets uuid::Uuid::new_v4(); an existing agent keeps its id and prefills model/baseUrl/protocol/contextBytes from agent/list
agent_configuration.local_validation: model 1..200 bytes; contextBytes 4096..1000000; baseUrl mirrors core Agent::validate (https, or http on localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]; no credentials/query/fragment). Host remains authoritative and its errors are surfaced verbatim
agent_configuration.protocol_field: toggle via Left/Right/Space between responses and chat_completions; not free text

connection_check.flow: agent/testConnection queues a real probe task; the client then polls agent/connectionResult every 900ms up to 100 times until the task is completed/failed/cancelled
connection_check.verdict: verified=true only when the task completed and the host observed both the connection_probe_ok result event and a usage event; capabilities = text/stream/function_tools. Anything else is reported as not verified
connection_check.display: pane history gets `[自检] 已排队连接探针任务 <id>` then `[自检] 通过：…` (green) or `[自检] 未通过：…` (yellow); the probe becomes the agent's latest task so the status row tracks it and Ctrl+C can cancel it
connection_check.bound: bounded polling; on timeout it stops and tells the user the probe may still be queued; a host error stops polling immediately

user_constraints.kinds: requirement / user_override / suggestion, toggled with Left/Right/Tab and marked with a filled bullet; the default is requirement
user_constraints.semantics: requirement and user_override are authoritative records the host injects into every model request and which outrank model decisions; suggestion is advisory. The modal states this
user_constraints.content: single line, <= 4096 bytes; spaces are content and never toggle the kind (regression-covered); empty content is rejected locally with a Chinese note
user_constraints.flow: event/publish returns a revision, the client then refreshes event/list so the record appears in the shared panel (F3) as `[用户] …` or `[建议] …`
user_constraints.host_authority: the kind whitelist, length limits and injection timing live in the host; the client only offers legal kinds and does not duplicate the check
user_constraints.irreversible: a published constraint cannot be retracted from the terminal; records are append-only by design and the modal says so

task_output.target: the focused pane's latest task from task/list; a pane without an agent or without a task only gets a note, no request is sent
task_output.content: persisted result summary (`result`, up to 16000 bytes, `[truncated]` marker), running public message draft (`draft.text`, empty once the task ends), the `full result` attachment read locally read-only and clipped to 100000 bytes, and an attachment inventory (label / bytes / path)
task_output.refresh: while the task is queued/running the client re-reads task/output every 800ms so the draft rolls; once the host marks the task terminal the next read picks up the attachment, polling stops and the hint switches from `运行中，自动刷新` to the static form. A task id absent from the current task/list snapshot is treated as finished and read once
task_output.keys: PgUp/PgDn scroll, Ctrl+R re-reads, Esc closes and clears the poll deadline; a host error stops polling and is echoed verbatim
task_output.attachment_reads: the client only reads files the host itself wrote (full result / file diff); paths come from artifact events, never from user input, and the client never writes, moves or lists directories

input_editing.scope: no contract method; the pane input line was append-only (insert at the end plus backspace)
input_editing.caret: Left/Right move by one whole character, Home/End jump to the line edges, Backspace/Delete remove one whole character before/under the caret; insert and paste happen at the caret, so multibyte text is never split. The caret is a UTF-8 byte offset and every edit entry point clamps it back onto a char boundary, so public-field writes cannot panic the renderer
input_editing.end_key: End keeps its existing 'back to the live tail' meaning while the pane history is scrolled, and moves the caret otherwise; PgUp/PgDn only scroll history
input_editing.history: Enter remembers the dispatched line per pane (max 100, immediate repeats skipped); Up walks back, stashing the in-progress draft on the first step, and Down restores that draft after the newest entry. History never leaks across panes or focus changes
input_editing.render: the input window is anchored at the end (shell-like) and only re-anchors at the caret when the caret would otherwise be off-screen; the cursor column is the display width of the text between the window start and the caret, counting CJK glyphs as two columns
input_editing.limit: unchanged 4096 bytes; hitting it still says 请分段输入

suite.ignored_reason: core runtime_e2e needs installed Codex; tui real-host smoke needs a built codex-collab-core

opt_in.real_host_smoke: passed: session/create, agent/configure, agent/list (carries contextBytes), task/list, approval/list, task/get, task/integrate, context/compact, agent/testConnection, agent/connectionResult, event/publish, task/output; non-UUID agent id and out-of-range contextBytes rejected; connectionResult reports verified=false with empty capabilities and rejects non-probe and unknown tasks; event/publish returns an increasing revision and rejects non-user kinds such as decision; task/output always returns taskId/result/draft (draft null or carrying text) and rejects unknown tasks; unknown approval/task ids and stale compaction revisions fail closed, empty summary rejected

pty_demo_smoke: passed: four panes, paste/send, caret editing (two Left presses then X yields `smoke-messaXge` on dispatch), stop, confirmed quit, terminal restoration, non-TTY rejection
pty_live_smoke: passed: seeded real session+agent via line protocol; Ctrl+A prefilled the seeded coordinator (edit path); Tabbed to a worker pane and added a second agent through the form; Ctrl+T queued a connection probe; Ctrl+O opened the probe task's output view and rendered its title, Esc closed it; Ctrl+U selected suggestion, typed text containing spaces, published, and F3 confirmed `[建议] keep … stable` in the shared records; coding toggle, review/compaction/create routing; masked credential form; confirmed quit and terminal restoration
footer: key hints on two lines above the feedback line: pane/global keys (Tab/F2/F3/Ctrl+A/Ctrl+Q) then task keys (Ctrl+T/Ctrl+U/Ctrl+O/Ctrl+E/Ctrl+G/Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N/Ctrl+K/Ctrl+R/Ctrl+C); a 132-column render test asserts no hint is clipped
pty_render_note: ratatui emits only changed cells, so spaces are absent from the pty byte stream; the live probe matches on non-space runs and record prefixes instead
screen_snapshot: scripts/snapshot_terminal.py replays the pty escape stream onto a screen grid and prints the reconstructed frame, so the UI can be reviewed and archived as text; evidence/stage-5-demo-screen.txt is the 40x132 demo frame, evidence/stage-5-output-screen.txt is the live task output view (the probe task really fails without a credential, so the modal shows a real persisted result), and --keys drives live mode to any modal before capturing
snapshot_tool_fix: when a double-width glyph claims a cell, the replayer now also clears a stale leading flag left there by the previous frame; without it the following write blanked the new glyph's trailing cell and CJK words rendered with a spurious space (the modal title showed `摘 要` instead of `摘要`)
cost_warning: the connection probe truly calls the model and may incur cost; the feedback line states this explicitly
evidence_script: scripts/stage5_evidence.sh replays the whole set (build -> workspace tests -> opt-in tests -> clippy -> fmt -> both pty probes -> both snapshots) and rewrites evidence/stage-5-tests.log
